trial_court: Senior Civil Judge and J.M.F.C., Hungund (M.C.No.3/2023)
case_name: Smt. Rajeshwari W/O. Shivanand Dandin vs Shri. Shivanand S/O. Durgappa Dandin
facts_of_case: Petitioner/wife filed for divorce against respondent/husband in M.C.No.199/2022 due to cruelty and desertion. Respondent/husband filed a petition in M.C.No.3/2023 seeking restitution of conjugal rights. Petitioner sought transfer of the matter from Hungund to Gadag.

legal_principles.principle: To avoid conflicting decisions, a petition pending in one court may be transferred to another court.
legal_principles.held: In order to avoid conflicting decisions, it is just and proper that the petition pending on the file of learned Senior Civil judge and J.M.F.C., Hungund, may be transferred to the learned Principal Family Court, Gadag.

legal_principles.principle: A party's willingness to accept the other party does not necessarily mean that the transfer of a petition is not justified.
legal_principles.held: He is all along ready and willing to accept the petitioner/wife but she has voluntarily deserted him

outcome.final_order: Petition is allowed, transferring MC No.3/2023 pending on the file of Senior Civil Judge and J.M.F.C., Hungund to Principal Family Court, Gadag.

use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce petition under Section 24 CPC
advising on transfer of matrimonial disputes to family court
assisting in property division and maintenance matters
